purpose: Carry existing exact Flash-Next CPU-oracle and Metal graph evidence into the per-model CPU/GPU/ANE Odyssey ledger without relabelling it as a complete-token placement result.
non_comparability: The CPU value is an oracle execution, not a repeated clean CPU placement control matched to the GPU timing protocol.
The GPU graph excludes the separately reported embedding read and is not a complete accepted token.
One bounded BOS-layer observation does not establish sustained latency, TPS, energy, or a backend-selection result.

requirements: clean repeated matched CPU and Metal controls for this exact scope
model-scoped public Core ML plan and runtime placement for an exact organ
matched ANE complete-work timing with transfer and synchronization
protected complete-token parity, capability, and wall-time evidence

claim_boundary: This is valid model-scoped diagnostic physical evidence. It is not a CPU-versus-GPU winner, ANE result, full-model runtime, complete-token TPS, capability result, EBPW result, or promotion.
